Regarding Collaborative Editing - for me, the holy grail would be something functionally equivalent to edditing a @notion.com database in table view.

Structured properties (eg not just strings but an array of enumerated values, int, …) over multiple Files (YAML headers) or API based CMS or a mix.

Is that a level of complexity and interactivity covered in the vision of collaborative editing?

Or: How far into the netlify Create, builder.io, DXP space are looking to go considering the data cascade can pull data from any API and editing would be „just another function call“

I would say that level of schema-driven data is definitely in scope! You’ll continue to be able to mix in data from any data source you’d like but all local-repo data will have the option to be schema driven!

Likely some overlap with this feature www.11ty.dev/docs/data-va...
